1.Sub-event_summary: XV Corps, having captured le Mans on 8 August with 5th Armored, 79th, and 90th Infantry Divisions, aimed north toward Alençon and then Carrouges-Sées, with open flanks; reinforced by 2d French Armored Division under Leclerc, while 80th Division under McBride protected the left rear at Evron amid fluid attachments.

External_Maps.External_Map_Description: Map 25-1 depicting XV Corps operations from Le Mans northward to Argentan and Ecouché, 8-13 August 1944, illustrating the fluid situation with open flanks relevant to rear area routes like Rouen-Bordeaux.
Map XXV-1 depicting XV Corps advance from Le Mans northward toward Alençon and Sées, part of the pursuit phase in August 1944, relevant to the Rennes-Paris axis.

1.Sub-event_summary: Situation on evening of 30 July, uncertainty about Avranches, evidence of German disorganization, and orders to push through to Sélune River.

9.Sub-event_summary: 1st SS and 2d Panzer arrived 13 August despite issues, committed piecemeal; 116th held Argentan, 2d at Ecouché, 1st SS between Carrouges and la Ferte-Mace; 9th Panzer destroyed; LXXXI Corps transferred 708th to Seventh Army, controlled remnants for east flank coverage.
